applies_to: config/news_sentiment_v1.json strategies N1-N4 (frozen; its own verdict rule is unchanged)
registration_note: Registered 2026-10-09, before the N1-N4 prospective start (2026-11-01), so no N-strategy forward day exists. It adds the required review methods of docs/RESEARCH_PROTOCOL.md. It is strictly additional: a book that fails the v1 rule fails; a book that passes v1 must also pass this review to be reported as PASS.

action_matched_null.N1_news_momentum: 999 books with the same weekly long/short counts and gross on random coins among those eligible that week (>= 3 mentions), review_methods.matched_random_selection_returns, seed 20261101; p_null <= 0.05 on mean daily return
action_matched_null.N2_attention_breakout: 999 books entering the same number of coins on the same days, chosen at random among coins with any mention in the prior 30 days, same 7-day hold and basket hedge; p_null <= 0.05
action_matched_null.N3_market_tone_following: 999 sign sequences that keep the observed number of long and short days and their run-length distribution (block-shuffled by run), p_null <= 0.05
action_matched_null.N4_news_panic_momentum_pause: 999 overlays pausing S2 on the same number of randomly placed days (blocks of the observed pause-spell lengths); the real overlay's blend Sharpe gain must exceed the 95th percentile

rules.test_family: {N1, N2, N3, N4}, Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 on the null p-values
rules.single_look: statistics computed once at the review date, guarded by review_methods.assert_single_look
rules.verdict: PASS only if the v1 rule passes, the null p <= 0.05 and the BH q-value <= 0.10; otherwise FAIL
